summary.text: Jim Grego represents District 17 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives. A Latimer County native, he owns and operates a cattle farm there.

paragraphs.text: Grego was born in McAlester, the eighth of 12 children, and the family lived on a small farm southwest of Wilburton.
He attended Eastern Oklahoma State College and Oklahoma State University, where he earned a bachelor's degree in animal science in 1977.
He worked for the U.S. Department of Agriculture in Texas before returning to Wilburton in 1986, and previously served as postmaster at the U.S. Post Office in Talihina.
He served 22 years as chairman of the Latimer County Conservation District and 20 years as chairman of the West End Fire Department.
Grego and his wife, Sandy, have been married for 44 years and have two children and two grandchildren.
